deepdive.thesis: EIL delivered strong Q2FY26 performance with 50% PBT growth and record order book of ₹13,131cr, driven by international consultancy wins and margin expansion; the key shift is sustained 25%+ consultancy margin despite LSTK revenue mix, and near-term catalysts are accelerating in hydrogen and overseas markets.

open.item: Panipat expansion under execution, to be completed in next ~1.5 years.
Ramagundam running at ~100% capacity as of 13 Feb; expects profit to continue in Q4 and next year (delivered INR42 cr JV profit in Q3).
FY26 order inflow at ~INR7,700 crores as of date; expects to cross INR8,000 crores by year-end.
Guided to cross INR4,000 crores revenue at the end of FY26 (from ~INR3,000 cr run-rate), with strong Q4.
Order inflow already crossed INR4,000 crores (H1 ~INR3,765 cr); expects to cross last year's ~INR8,000 crores mark.
IOCL Paradip Phase-1 on a ~10-month schedule; Phase-2 to be awarded after Phase-1 report submission and board approval.
Targeting to at least match last year's ~INR8,000 crores order inflow with 10-20% upside as an internal target.
Bina and Kochi refinery expansions expected to happen within about 1 year, becoming project opportunities.
NRL 9 MMTPA expansion expected to complete around middle or end of next year, with revenue/dividend to follow.
IOCL Paradip Phase-2 order now expected to be booked in next financial year (FY27) after IOCL's investment decision, not this fiscal.
INR4,000 crores set as the minimum revenue target for next year (FY27) as well.
Aims to maintain ~INR8,000 crores order inflow next year and try to add 10-15% more.
INR5,000 crores annual turnover target expected to be achieved by FY28.
Conducting internal studies and technology-provider talks on carbon capture (CCUS) following budget allocation; expects something to develop.
Strategic shift toward international markets (Nigeria/Africa, Middle East - Saudi/Oman/Kuwait/Abu Dhabi, South America) for higher-quality, higher-margin work.
Infrastructure ~25-30% of order inflow, expected to continue at that level.
Maintaining operating profit of more than 10% on a regular basis.
Turnkey/OBE LSTK segment margin guided ~7% (6%-7%) for the longer period.
Consultancy segment profit guided 20%-25% (22%-25% band).
Major projects execute over 36-48 months; first year yields only ~10-15% turnover, 25-30% in years 2-3.

verdicts.item: Management guided for 5% to 10% turnover growth in the next financial year (FY24).
verdicts.note: expired: no update 7Q past horizon Q4FY24

verdicts.item: Focusing UAE operations to become a hub of engineering activities in the Middle East market.
verdicts.note: Empaneled with ADNOC group for engineering services; strong UAE/Middle East order focus - hub delivering.

verdicts.item: Targeting turnover of around INR3,500-3,600 crores next year at ~10% growth.
verdicts.note: expired: no update 7Q past horizon Q4FY24

verdicts.item: Maintaining consultancy segment profit of 20% to 25% on a regular basis.
verdicts.note: 'segment profit of 20% to 25% on the Consultancy business' - within the maintained 20-25% band.

verdicts.item: Targeting LSTK/OBE segment margin of around 5% to 6%.
Expects full-year EBITDA margin in line with last year's ~8.8% despite lower first two quarters.
verdicts.note: expired: no update 3Q past horizon Q4FY25

verdicts.item: FY25 revenue expected around INR3,200-3,500 crores; will hit INR3,500 crores if change orders are finalized, else similar to last year (~INR3,200 cr).
verdicts.note: FY25 revenue ~INR3,000cr landed at the downside 'similar to last year' scenario; the INR3,500 change-order upside not achieved. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: EPCM/consultancy segment profit around 20% on a sustainable basis.
verdicts.note: EPCM/consultancy segment profit 20-25% - at/above the ~20% sustainable target.

verdicts.item: Aims to sustain and at least increase the all-time-high order book of ~INR11,000 crores.
verdicts.note: 'the current order book stands at around INR15,670 crores... highest order book position in the history of EIL' - well above ~INR11,000cr.

verdicts.item: Believes INR4,000-5,000 crores annual consultancy order intake run-rate can be maintained over next 1-2 years.
verdicts.note: Consultancy dominates inflow (Dangote refinery ~INR3,250cr consultancy); consultancy order book jumped to ~INR10,700cr - run-rate maintained/exceeded.

verdicts.item: Expects substantial increase in turnover in FY26 and FY27 as recent big orders ramp beyond the low first-year revenue recognition.
verdicts.note: 9M turnover INR2,951cr vs INR2,037cr (+45%); FY26 to exceed INR4,000cr from ~INR3,000cr - substantial increase materializing.
